name: export-pdf
description: Export the front Pages document as PDF using AppleScript export command with POSIX file path

steps.script:
-- export-pdf: Export the front Pages document as PDF
-- Replace /tmp/output.pdf with your desired output path
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		export to POSIX file "/tmp/SH_Test.pdf" as PDF
	end tell
end tell
